title: Stacking
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#321, 2026-10-05), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.6 beta, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, environment in D3DMetal mode, rated 4 of 5. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on the default engine. A Direct3D 9 game, so it draws through DXVK's Direct3D 9 in every graphics mode but wined3d, whatever the environment's mode says. The reporter found the picture noticeably darker than the Xbox 360 version at the same resolution; whether the Windows release looks the same on Windows is not established. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: Picture darker than the Xbox 360 version
knownIssues.cause: not established; the PC port may simply be darker
knownIssues.fix: the game's own brightness or gamma setting, if it has one
